statement: Linux hid-steam lizard_mode default true is host policy; sc26re replacement initializes lizard and mappings true, default key9 and key71 true, and implements a ten-second restore timer on lizard-off writes. OpenPuck receiver has a seven-second fallback and SDL sends lizard-disable about every three seconds. Stock wired Triton firmware initial state, actual watchdog expiry, reboot persistence and USB detach semantics remain unmeasured by this source lane.
